children: Leopold Aschenbrenner, through Situational Awareness funds, disclosed a 21.1% stake in SharonAI Holdings Inc.’s Class A common stock. The position became reportable on Aug. 27, 2026, and the group filed a Schedule 13D the next day. The holdings include common shares and prefunded warrants, signaling a sizable, research-driven bet on the company.

Situational Awareness bought the shares for investment and states it does not seek to change control at SharonAI Holdings. The filing says they "have not acquired any securities of the Issuer with the purpose or effect of changing or influencing control." The group plans to keep watching the company’s operations, strategy, and stock performance as it evaluates next steps.

They may buy more shares, sell shares, use hedges, or talk with other shareholders as they monitor the business and stock. At the same time, they note they have "no present plan or proposal" for actions listed under Item 4, though they may recommend steps to management or the board if conditions change. Any move would depend on how the company performs and how market conditions evolve.

Leopold Aschenbrenner is the managing partner and control person of Situational Awareness LP and SAF AI GP LP, which oversee Situational Awareness Partners LP. The firm is a Delaware-based investment manager that advises and manages funds and has authority over voting and dispositions for client accounts. Aschenbrenner focuses on artificial intelligence and technology investments, pursuing concentrated positions informed by technical and market research.
